end.summary:
Recognised that fractions require equal-sized parts.
Named halves, thirds and quarters of shapes with some prompting.
Explored that the denominator shows the number of equal parts in one whole.
Practised finding one-third of 9 as 3; collection-fraction teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sharing shapes and collections into equal groups, using roti and ladoo examples. Nisha explained clearly that unequal pieces cannot be called thirds or quarters; the mix-up between the number of parts and the size of one share was revisited later in the lesson. At home, ask them to split small groups of objects into 2, 3, or 4 equal groups and name one group as a fraction.
